scope: One recorded observation per before/cold-after/warm-after case on a shared Linux host, same16retained metadata excerpts. No SDK/database/model/product call. Timers cover verify(evidence), including metadata parsing/validation, log checks and canonical evidence digest; exclude interpreter startup/imports, input loading and Git source-byte verification. Future probes produce new observations, not identical timings. No statistical latency/speedup or product-search claim.

memory.additional_object_overhead: lookup table, Python/cache objects; not measured

scan_scope: Scalar table-byte counts cover only byte visits in the Python CRC recurrence for large tables. They exclude header/footer CRCs, reconstruction/copying, byte-key hashing/equality scans, metadata comparisons, log/canonical SHA hashing and all other memory traffic; they are not total bytes transferred.

full_suite_scan_audit.scope: instrumented full test process including deliberate cache eviction tests and rehashed mutations; unchanged original table is not rescanned per excerpt

measurement_precision: Full clock-derived float values retained; shared-host single observations, not repeated distributions.
probe_inputs_scope: Prospective package input pins after missing-tree handling; original after_inputs_sha256 above retain the exact historical measured-source identities. The modified source-binding Git availability path is outside the metadata-only timed path.
